main.description: Publish an AGGREGATE-FIRST 決算 intel report + the derived metrics / aggregates (:fin.metric/* + :fin.agg/*, all :synthesized) into the kotoba Datom log. NON-ADJUDICATING (G2) + NO investment advice (G4): every figure is a company-disclosed value or a transparent ratio of disclosed values. Metrics/aggregates are NEVER re-ingested as disclosed facts (G5); Σ aggregates are coverage-bounded (read against n), never a market total; cross-currency sums are NOT computed (no FX layer, R0).

metric.description: one derived per-company ratio / YoY (:fin.metric/*, always :synthesized)

valueBp.description: the ratio in BASIS POINTS (fraction × 10000, implied units — e.g. 1180 = 11.8%). Integer to satisfy the implied-units rule; a YoY decline is negative

basis.description: the fact ids the metric was derived from (audit trail)

aggregate.description: one sector / currency aggregate (:fin.agg/*, always :synthesized, coverage-honest)

sum.description: Σ across ingested members as an INTEGER in the scale units of the concept (implied units) — NOT a market total (G5)

currency.description: currency of the sum (aggregates are never summed across currencies — no FX layer, R0)

n.description: coverage denominator — read every aggregate against n
